title: SCHC active sender accepts ACK bitmap bits for unassigned FCNs
description: Post-fix correctness review: active-session ACK parsing calls `Ack.from_bytes(data)` without the active transfer assigned FCNs, allowing authenticated C=0 ACKs with bits in unassigned short-window positions to drive retransmission or abort transitions. Derive exact FCNs assigned in `ack.window`, pass them into parsing before any state mutation, and run the malformed vector through the link-issued sender and authenticated receipt with no attempt or status mutation.
